boundary: The wedge theorem is a homotopy-equivalence certificate assembled from simplicial collapses and elementary Tietze transformations. It is stronger than homology alone; no claim of a pure simplicial collapse directly to the wedge triangulation is made.
theorem: The full clique complex of J(8,3) is homotopy equivalent to a wedge of 125 two-spheres. An explicit sequence of 518 elementary simplicial collapses reduces it to a 2-complex, after which 365 elementary presentation eliminations remove every edge generator and leave 125 trivially attached 2-cells.
